messages:
incident-bot: Paging: p99 latency breach on /v1/chat/generate (service: inference-api). Severity: Sev2. Trigger: p99 > 5s for 5m. Autoflow: notified #incidents and on-call. Incident ID INC-2026-0423-13

maria: ack. oncall here — looking. saw alerts ~10:12 UTC.

devon: noticed canary traffic shift to canary-v13 ~10:05 UTC from deploy-bot. rolling 20% -> 100% in 15m window.

aj: oncall-eng — grabbing dashboards, pulling p95/p99 timeseries now.

sre-lead: summary pls: is this tail-only or systemic? any error spike?

aj: quick numbers from metrics: baseline p95 ~120ms. current p95 ~880ms. p99 spiked from ~2.5s -> 6.2s. error rate (5xx) unchanged (~0.02%) but streaming stall rate increased to 4.8% (was 0.2%).

amelia: streaming sessions show repeated 'chunk timeout' in the inference runtime logs around the same time. suspect new model variant kv-cache warmup or tokenizer slowdown.

devon: customers reporting slow chat responses and some partial streams. ACMEInc (#acct-114) flagged a support ticket about truncated responses.

customer-support: ticket created INC-ACME-211, severity high for them. sending initial notification.

maria: can we cut canary traffic back to 0% while we triage? need rollback plan.

deploy-bot: Rollout canary-v13 -> canary-v13-attempt-1 completed. Traffic policy: 20% at 10:05, 50% at 10:08, 100% at 10:20.

aj: agree cut. I'm opening traffic route change now. will reassign 100% -> stable at ingress.

ops: doing immediate traffic reweight to stable (v12) in the load-router. ETA ~40s.

maria: logs for canary pods show repeated WARN: 'kv_cache_miss' and tail GC spikes peaking at 1.2s on token decode. snippet:
```
[2026-04-23T10:11:14Z] WARN runtime: kv_cache_miss seq=102347 model=canary-v13 shard=3
[2026-04-23T10:11:14Z] INFO decoder: token_decode 1200ms (p95)
```

sre-lead: that aligns with latency. could be new model size causing more kv thrash. any quantization differences?

amelia: v13 uses q4f16 static fallback compared to v12 q4f32 with different kernel. runtime kernel selection may be falling back to slower path for certain sequence lengths.

devon: are we seeing same behavior on dedicated pools? or only hosted canary?

aj: initial check: dedicated pools (res-south) unaffected. this is isolated to hosted canary fleet. suggests model variant or runtime behavior in canary shape.

maria: traffic reweight complete. canary -> 0% at 10:12:50. p99 falling?

aj: p99 started to decline after cut but still elevated — likely cleanup of in-flight sessions and some streaming sessions still stuck. p99 at 3.1s now. streaming stall rate dropping from 4.8% -> 1.1%.

sre-lead: good. next steps: preserve logs/metrics for forensics, tag canary-v13 bundles, and rollback permanently until root cause known. open a rollback/change ticket and mark as halted.

maria: creating incident doc and timeline in hg:INC-2026-0423-13. Capturing metrics: attach traces, sample request ids.

devon: can we run a smoke test on canary-v13 with short sequences to reproduce? and run kv-cache heatmap tooling?

amelia: I'll spin a isolated test harness against canary-v13 in a sandbox (no traffic) and run prefix-heavy workload.

ops: note: there were 1.5k affected requests in the 10:05-10:12 window, ~0.09% of total qps but high tail. possible customer-visible for streaming.

customer-support: updated ACMEInc that engineers are investigating and we rolled traffic back. SLA impact estimate: increased latency, partial responses for some sessions — offering mitigation credit if they request.

aj: quick checklist for postmortem: 1) confirm model artifact differences (tokenizer, quant) 2) check runtime kernel selection logs 3) validate KV cache sizing/eviction 4) verify rollout automation ramp constraints 5) improve smoke tests for streaming long-tail.

sre-lead: also add alert tuning: we want earlier signal at streaming stall delta + kv_miss rate so we catch before p99 > 5s.

devon: agree. product: evaluate whether v13 model changes are worth reintroducing; need perf acceptance gates.

maria: handoff: I'll stay on until handover to evening oncall at 18:00 UTC. leaving detailed notes in incident doc.

amelia: sandbox repro running now — I'll post results.

ops: created rollback ticket CHG-2026-0042 and paused automated canary runs.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback action queued by ops.

sre-lead: high-level customer impact: small fraction of requests affected but high latency for streaming -> visible to chat UX. Sev2 response appropriate.

devon: closing live mitigation: traffic cut success. moving to investigation/forensics. will update thread with repro and RCA plan.

maria: thanks all. tagging folks for followups: @sre-lead @amelia @devon @ops @customer-support.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0423-13 moved to 'investigating'. Next update expected 1h or when we have repro.
